source.name: Gaia Data Release 3 · gaia_source_lite
source.query: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_over_error, phot_g_mean_mag, bp_rp FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source_lite WHERE parallax >= 0.2 AND parallax_over_error >= 10 AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 12 AND bp_rp IS NOT NULL ORDER BY source_id
